decisions.reason: GA4 is now Google's only analytics standard, so demand for the tracking plugin is still developing, and keeping a plugin on the market costs little compared with its option value.
Google shut down Universal Analytics in 2023–2024, so the uncertainty has resolved against this plugin and its maintenance resources are better moved to the GA4 plugin and other projects.
Linking shops to retail systems fits the firm's interface-development strength, and the plugin's value is still uncertain while upkeep stays modest, so the option is worth holding.
This SEO service draws on existing staff skills at little added cost, fits steady relaunch demand, and its dedicated page signals a deliberate commitment.
